_comment: Shape of data/learned.json, which scripts/promote.mjs --apply writes and this repo does not track (see .gitignore): promoted entries carry example snippets pulled from the real text they were mined from, so the file is kept out of a public repo by design. Its absence is the normal state of a fresh clone — analyze.mjs treats a missing learned.json as an empty list, silently. Copy this file to data/learned.json only to hand-seed learned state for testing; normally promote.mjs creates and grows it.

examples: ...our platform leverages cutting-edge technology to unlock seamless value for every team...
